name: Account selector
purpose: The from/to account picker of every payment flow plus its compact inline token. Two forms: a SELECTOR (combobox trigger showing the chosen account — name, masked number, balance — opening a listbox of rich account rows; the Dropdown field mechanics with account-shaped options) and a MASKED ACCOUNT CHIP (the chosen account as an inline token for confirmation rows and form summaries). Masked convention promoted from Account-card: middle-dot triple + last four (···4821), never the full number.

props.name: accounts
props.$note: Rows of {name, masked, balance}; balances render via the Amount-display primitive (tabular figures, copy-025).

props.name: label
props.$note: Field label above the trigger ('From account'); part of the combobox accessible name.

props.name: form
props.$note: Chip = read-only inline token (role=group + aria-label); selector = the interactive picker.

variants.name: selector
variants.use: Choosing among the user's accounts in payment/transfer forms.

variants.name: chip
variants.use: Restating the chosen account in confirmations and summaries — compact, read-only.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — names .t-cm-label (.em selected) · masked .t-cm-legal at 0.6 ink · balances .t-cm-figure-5/6 (tabular) · field label .t-cm-caption
tokens.field: form/border/default · active form/border/active (border + inset accent, the Dropdown pattern) · hover form/background/hover
tokens.menu: background/default + elevation/border (dark outline) + elevation/functional shadow — mode-aware elevation (Dropdown recipe)
tokens.selected: form/background/hover fill + inset form/border/active accent + .em name
tokens.chip: form/border/default outline on the INDICATOR radius role (the Account-card tag spec, namespaced .acchip — .chip is type.css-bound)
tokens.$physics: NO press physics by design — form-control family (Dropdown/Input-fields), not button-family; a possible field component-type group is raised in the receipt.

motion.chevron: Rotates 180° on open (140ms); menu shows/hides without transform.

responsive.rule: Trigger 360px max-width 100%; menu matches trigger width; rows keep name left, balance right, tabular figures aligned.

mustNotNeighbour: A raw <select> for the same choice (rich rows exist for a reason)
commonPatterns: chip restating the choice in the confirm step

accessibility.role: Trigger role="combobox" + aria-haspopup="listbox" + aria-expanded + aria-controls + aria-labelledby (label + value); menu role="listbox"; rows role="option" + aria-selected. Chip: role="group" + aria-label.
accessibility.name: Masked numbers announce as 'ending 4821' via aria-label — dots are visual only.
accessibility.keyboard: ↑ ↓ Home End move; Enter/Space select; Esc closes and returns focus; Tab closes and moves on.
accessibility.focus: Visible :focus-visible (focus/ring) on the trigger; keyboard row focus = 2px inset ring.
accessibility.nonText: Field border form/border/default ≥3:1 vs page both modes (1.4.11); selection is never colour-alone (fill + inset accent + weight).

antiPatterns: Showing a full account number anywhere (masked convention: ···last-four only)
Masked dots with no screen-reader equivalent (aria-label 'ending NNNN' is mandatory)
Selection carried by colour alone (fill + inset accent + weight, always)
Using the .chip classname (type.css blast-radius escape — .acchip is the namespace)
Press physics on a form control (field family, not button-family)
Proportional figures for balances (columns shear — tabular always)

tokenValidation.against: token store (semantic-colour.json) via #token-manifest — field bindings mirror Dropdown (gated green)
tokenValidation.result: PASS — bound vars match resolved light+dark; text pairs ≥14.9:1; border 3.94/3.94 (ui ≥3).
tokenValidation.$note: Built Phase-2 wave 1 (worker B). Field component-type group question raised in the receipt (Worker A owns the forms lane).

mustNotNeighbour.$note: A raw <select> for the same choice (rich rows exist for a reason)
